licensing.additional: No additional HMO licensing scheme found; national mandatory HMO licensing (five or more people from two or more households) applies. The council has proposed an Article 4 direction so that new small HMOs would need planning permission.

housing: Reigate and Banstead is a prosperous commuter borough, with large detached and semi-detached houses in Banstead, Kingswood, Tadworth and on Reigate's hills. Redhill has more Victorian terraces, flats over shops and new apartment blocks near the station, and the number of HMOs there has grown quickly in recent years. Merstham has a large post-war estate under regeneration, while Horley, close to Gatwick, has grown with big new-build neighbourhoods. Private renting is a modest share of homes but rents are high.
checkinTips: Shared houses and bedsits in Redhill: photograph each bedroom lock, fire doors, alarms and the shared kitchen and bathroom separately.
New apartment blocks near Redhill and Reigate stations: note fob counts, parking bays, bike stores and balconies.
New-build homes in Horley: record snagging marks, sealant, new turf and fences, and window seals that matter for aircraft noise.
Large detached houses in Banstead, Kingswood and Tadworth: photograph garden equipment, gates, driveways and any outbuildings or pools listed in the tenancy.
Post-war estate homes in Merstham: photograph communal areas, garages and older windows and boilers.
tenantHelp: Tenants can report disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions in privately rented homes to Reigate and Banstead Borough Council's environmental health team.
